text:
Maya Patel: Hey team — bad timing but my flight out of SFO got delayed. I need someone to take primary for 06:00-14:00 UTC today. I can stay shadow/phone for the first hour if needed.

Leo Chen: I can pick up primary for the window if Amanda is ok with secondary. I have local availability and laptop on me.

Amanda Ruiz: I can do secondary until 10:00 UTC, then I have a meeting. If Leo takes primary that's fine.

Pranav Sinha: If Leo is primary and Amanda drops at 10:00, I can be hot-shadow 10:00-14:00 in case anything pages. Happy to take an escalated pager if it flips.

Maya Patel: Thanks all. Can we confirm handoff steps so pagerbot and rotation metadata are updated? Runbook says to update oncall roster and add the temporary note in the channel.

oncall-bot: Current rotation: Primary=Maya Patel (until 06:00 UTC), Secondary=Amanda Ruiz. To request swap, post in #eng-oncall with the desired window and mention both parties. See runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/oncall/handovers

Maya Patel: Doing that now. Tagging @Leo and @Pranav — if Leo confirms I'll update the schedule and trigger the temporary swap.

Leo Chen: Confirmed. I'll take primary 06:00-14:00 UTC. Please update pager assignments. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: Updated rotation metadata and added note to roster: "06:00-14:00 UTC temporary primary: Leo Chen (covering for delayed travel — Maya shadow first hour). Secondary: Amanda Ruiz until 10:00 UTC, then Pranav Sinha hot-shadow."

pagerbot: Assignment change processed. New primary: Leo Chen. New secondary: Amanda Ruiz. Temporary notes: see channel. Pager escalation unchanged.

Amanda Ruiz: Thanks — I put my OOO-block 10:00-11:00 in calendar but will be reachable by phone if anything pages.

Pranav Sinha: I'll stand by 09:45 UTC and be ready to take the secondary if Amanda needs to drop. Quick checklist I recommend on handover: 1) verify pager routing to new primary 2) run canary curl, 3) confirm token/key access, 4) ensure runbook links posted.

Leo Chen: Can we do the simple canary now?

Maya Patel: Yep — run this from terminal to check runtime health:

```
# quick canary
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST_TOKEN" https://runtime.redwood.internal/v1/health || echo "health failed"
```

Leo Chen: Canary returned OK. Latencies look normal.

Maya Patel: Final step: if anything escalates to sev2+ please page both primary and secondary and escalate to L2 on Slack with the incidentbot command. Example: `/incident create --sev 2 --service runtime --owner @Leo Chen`

Pranav Sinha: Noted. I'll be on standby and will join voice if we get repeated token errors (saw that in the last window).

Leo Chen: All set on my end. Thanks Maya — safe travels.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. I'll watch the channel until handoff completes and then switch to shadow. Feel free to ping me if you want me to join the pager escalation call. :airplane:

pagerbot: Reminder scheduled: 05:50 UTC — new primary check (Leo Chen) and secondary check (Amanda Ruiz).

Amanda Ruiz: Received reminder. :white_check_mark:

Leo Chen: I'll update the post-handoff note at 06:05 UTC with any abnormalities.

Maya Patel: Closing thread — swap confirmed.
